# Bagseven

> Infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. Operators sign in with World. SaaS merchants define thin Plans and open Checkout Sessions. Buyers pay USDT on Whitechain (WhiteWallet-ready). Paid sessions mint living Arkiv entitlements. Humans and agents check/consume through an SDK. Agents spend under a mandate dual-gate.

## Start

pnpm setup
pnpm start:local

Landing http://localhost:3001
Dashboard http://localhost:3000/app  (World-primary login; email OTP verify-later)
Plans http://localhost:3000/app/plans
Checkouts http://localhost:3000/app/checkouts
Account http://localhost:3000/app/account
SDK playground http://localhost:3000/app/sdk
Embed portal http://localhost:3000/embed?token=
Public checkout http://localhost:3000/checkout?session=cs_…
Gateway :4000  Daemon :4001  Policy :4003

## What this repo is

Monorepo (pnpm + turbo). Two product surfaces only:

- apps/landing — Fianto-style marketing
- apps/console — operator dashboard (/app) + /embed + /checkout

Backend: services/gateway, services/daemon, services/policy
Libraries: packages/sdk, packages/entitlements, packages/world, packages/notify, packages/db, packages/money, packages/onchain, packages/server

## SDK flow

1. World login (operator)
2. createPlan → createCheckoutSession
3. BagsevenEmbed checkoutSessionId (WhiteWallet / EVM pay)
4. Living Arkiv grant
5. checkEntitlement / FeatureFlagGuard / MCP consume

@bagseven/sdk/react — Provider, FeatureFlagGuard, BagsevenEmbed (portal | checkout | …)
@bagseven/sdk/node — checkEntitlement, consumeEntitlement, identify, createPlan, createCheckoutSession
@bagseven/sdk/wallet — connectWhitechainWallet, payUsdtOnWhitechain
@bagseven/sdk/agent — programmatic agent wrapper

Public API:
GET /v1/check  GET /v1/entitlements  POST /v1/usage/consume  POST /v1/access-tokens  POST /v1/credits
POST /v1/plans  GET /v1/plans  POST /v1/checkout-sessions
GET /v1/public/checkout/:id  POST /v1/public/checkout/:id/confirm
Demo: pnpm sdk:demo

## Dual-gate (IP)

Payment clock = Whitechain (payment_tx)
Renewal clock = customer-authorized Whitechain subscription + durable scheduler; grant.renewal_enabled mirrors intent (cancel does not kill paid_through). Monthly checkout uses 30-day wallet pulls, not a standalone USDT transfer.
Access clock = Arkiv grant remaining + TTL — queryable object

paid_run / secret consume use prepaid grants without a mandate. New USDT payments via bagseven_fetch require mandate remaining AND a living grant. Dashboard /app/mandate manages owner-signed spending permissions.

## Auth

World is primary (IDKit / mock). Session cookie bagseven_session (HMAC, 8h).
Email is optional — verify later via 6-digit OTP. Magic link is recovery/invite only.

## MCP tools

bagseven_status, grant_status, check_entitlement, consume_entitlement, mint_with_world, buy_credits, create_checkout_session, paid_run, cancel_renewal, explain_denial, bagseven_fetch, list_subscriptions, get_subscription, cancel_subscription
Bind one worker: BAGSEVEN_MCP_WORKER=<uuid> pnpm mcp:local

## Tracks (mock vs live)

World: WORLD_MOCK_PROOFS vs WORLD_RP_* / WORLD_CLIENT_ID
Whitechain: WHITECHAIN_DEMO_SETTLE vs buyer-signed USDT + WHITECHAIN_USDT
Arkiv: ENTITLEMENT_STORE=memory vs ARKIV_ACCESS_KEY + ARKIV_PRIVATE_KEY

## Do not

- Add a third web app or port 3010 inspector
- Put operator keys in client JS (publishable + embed token only)
- Add payment-link product line / products catalog / invoices
- Weaken fail-closed policy / spend_token (docs/DECISIONS.md)
